top_signals.title: Demiralp: Inflation Outlook Blocking Turkey Rate Ease
top_signals.summary: Turkey's central bank said it would resume weekly repo auctions at its 37% policy rate. The decision is a step towards normalizing funding conditions as the central bank bets the worst of the Iran War's economic fallout has passed. Selva Demiralp, Professor of Economics at Koç University spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the move from the Central Bank & its impact on inflation in Turkey. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump administration plans to revoke visas of foreigners seeking asylum
top_signals.summary: If realized, the move could be the largest single mass revocation of visas in U.S. history.
